findings.statement: Current certification verifier is stale/dirty after scoped audit and planning changes.
findings.negative_proof: certification:verify and evidence:verify must fail on stale candidate bytes and pass only on the final clean candidate.

findings.statement: Production preflight is declarative and not yet proven mandatory at API/worker bootstrap.
findings.negative_proof: Forged readiness flags or missing durable dependencies must terminate bootstrap before serving.

findings.statement: Maturity scores are substantially derived from binary gate counts and can report 99 without nuanced proof quality.
findings.negative_proof: Known-bad, missing, stale and externally blocked fixtures must not produce a high score or GO.

findings.statement: Provider, channel, external identity, institutional RAG, physical RPO/RTO, pilot, rollback and human signoff are unavailable locally.
findings.negative_proof: Absent external evidence remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and production remains NO_GO.

areas.public_boundary: HTTP inbound -> persisted Goal/Plan/Step/Attempt/Evaluation -> governed worker continuation
areas.negative_case: Cycle, deadline, cumulative budget exhaustion, stale lease and restart must terminate or continue from persisted state without reset/replay.

areas.public_boundary: Repository and migration boundary under disposable PostgreSQL with tenant context and lease fencing
areas.negative_case: Double claim, CAS race, expired lease, tenant mismatch, interrupted migration and logical restore must preserve invariants.

areas.public_boundary: Synthetic inbound -> SQL/outbox -> worker -> policy/approval -> journal -> controlled adapter -> audit
areas.negative_case: Crash before/after adapter invocation, lost acknowledgement, replay, takeover or approval race must never duplicate an effect; ambiguity is UNCERTAIN.

areas.public_boundary: HTTP/auth envelope -> tenant resolver -> policy/approval -> persistence/audit/logging
areas.negative_case: Untrusted actor, cross-tenant input, prompt/tool/channel injection, approval replay, stale worker and secret-bearing logs fail closed without leakage/effect.

areas.public_boundary: Prompt/PRD/SPEC/bar -> task evidence -> candidate manifest/pointer -> verifier/promotion decision
areas.negative_case: Stale, dirty, untracked, scope-drifted or recalculation-inconsistent evidence must be rejected; external blockers cannot be hidden by scores.

areas.public_boundary: Node 22 test, coverage, mutation, PostgreSQL, E2E, eval, chaos, security and supply-chain gates
areas.negative_case: Mandatory skips, stale logs, implementation-mirroring tests and selected policy/fencing/certification mutants must not pass.

areas.public_boundary: Tenant-scoped read-only API read model -> rendered operator console
areas.negative_case: Loading, empty, error/retry, approval, handoff, budget, loop and UNCERTAIN states remain truthful, accessible and tenant-scoped at 375/768/1440.

areas.public_boundary: AGENTS/runtime state/execution log/backlog/plan/roadmap/evidence synchronized with executable behavior
areas.negative_case: A task cannot be marked complete without contract, command result, evidence location, limitations and next action; stale metadata reopens certification.

areas.public_boundary: Bootstrap/deploy preflight -> external qualification -> operational recovery/pilot -> human release decision
areas.negative_case: Missing provider/channel/IdP/RAG, physical RPO/RTO, pilot, rollback or signoff must keep the system BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/NO_GO.

tasks.negative: unowned or unmapped criterion is not closable
NOT_EXECUTED/external evidence cannot yield high score/GO
mandatory skip or selected mutant cannot pass
missing stage/sensitive content cannot be silent
stale/dirty candidate cannot verify or promote
fixtures cannot mark real provider/channel/IdP/RAG PASS

tasks.proof: physical RPO/RTO, rollback and pilot unavailable
tasks.negative: disposable PostgreSQL cannot prove physical recovery

closure_rule: A row is PASS only with current executable evidence bound to the final candidate/config; document existence alone is insufficient. External and human rows remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL until authorized evidence exists.
